components.claimed_capability: Principal-component-analysis-based market absorption ratio as a systemic-risk indicator.
components.runtime_evidence: REAL-FIXED 2026-07-10: pca_factor_decomposition()/absorption_ratio() in advanced_quant_indicators.py were real but had zero call sites anywhere in the live system. Wiring plan (architect-approved): advisory vote into the existing market_regime_overlay.combine_regime_votes() 6-indicator ensemble (chosen because absorption ratio is a market-wide risk-appetite signal, not a per-ticker one -- the regime overlay is the only consumer that already operates at that level). Added market_regime_overlay.pca_absorption_indicator(returns_matrix, n_factors=5, high_thresh=0.65, low_thresh=0.35): vote=-1 (fragile/correlated market, idiosyncratic edges more likely to get overrun) when AR>=0.65, vote=+1 (stock-picker's market) when AR<=0.35, else neutral 0; guarded by _PCA_AVAILABLE import flag. Threaded new optional returns_matrix param through combine_regime_votes() and get_weekly_regime_check() (7th indicator now; docstrings/tool descriptions updated 6->7 throughout main.py). Added main.py:_build_pca_returns_matrix(lookback_days=90, top_n=50): queries polygon_market_daily for the top-50-by-dollar-volume liquid universe over the lookback window (not a fixed index list -- avoids survivorship bias), pivots to a (dates x tickers) daily-return matrix, returns None (never raises) on insufficient data so the indicator degrades to neutral rather than crashing the whole regime check. Wired into both existing call sites: _aiem_tool_regime_overlay_check and _aiem_tool_regime_overlay_manual now pass returns_matrix=_build_pca_returns_matrix() into get_weekly_regime_check(). Unit-tested in isolation first with synthetic correlated (AR=0.99->vote=-1) and idiosyncratic (AR=0.23->vote=+1) return matrices to confirm both vote directions fire correctly before any live wiring. Added a new permanent ADMIN_TOKEN-gated endpoint POST /stock-api/admin/regime-overlay-check that synchronously runs the exact same _aiem_tool_regime_overlay_check code path an AIEM agent session hits. Live-fired proof after workflow restart: real call against live polygon_market_daily data (50-ticker universe incl. MU/SPY/NVDA/QQQ/TSLA/AAPL/MSFT, 90-day window, 60x50 pivoted return matrix) produced absorption ratio 0.78 (>=0.65 threshold) -> genuine vote=-1, correctly contributing to a real 'reduce_exposure' overall recommendation (total_score=-1, 2 bearish/1 bullish/5 neutral of 8 total indicators). Downstream persistence confirmed by direct DB read: agent_decisions row id=30355 (2026-07-10 18:57:14 UTC), decision_type='no_trade', reasoning text includes the absorption-ratio sentence verbatim, confirming get_weekly_regime_check()'s dl.log_decision() call captured the new indicator's contribution exactly as it would for a live scheduled/agent-triggered run -- not a special test-only code path.

components.claimed_capability: Thompson-weighted 2-of-3-registered-specialist verdict computed via ONE canonical factory (specialist_council.run_council()), called from two live sites (paper-trade candidate scoring -> context='candidate_entry' seats {signal_engine, fred_macro}; 4PM mark-to-market exit judgment -> context='mtm_exit' seats {technicals, fred_macro}). A deterministic confidence-weighted-mean tie-breaker (negotiate()/_llm_coordinate(), NOT an LLM call despite the name) is available for split votes. Every call persists one evidence row to aiem_specialist_council_runs recording registered/invoked/abstained member counts so a missing member can never silently look like a full council.
components.runtime_evidence: REOPENED 2026-07-10 after the prior RESOLVED_DOCUMENTATION_CORRECTION verdict was found to be WRONG: main.py had TWO call sites each inline-constructing a DIFFERENT ad-hoc SpecialistOpinion list (site1 ~L41453 signal_engine+fred_macro; site2 ~L43770 technicals+fred_macro) and sharing only compute_weighted_verdict() -- this violates remediation Section 3 Rule B ('no call site may independently construct a partial council') regardless of member count. REAL FIX: added COUNCIL_REGISTRY + _build_opinion() + run_council() + init_schema() + persist_council_run() to specialist_council.py as the ONE canonical construction path; refactored both main.py call sites to call run_council() instead of building SpecialistOpinion objects inline. Vote math is verbatim (moved, not changed) -- confirmed via before/after diff. Live-fired proof after workflow restart: aiem_specialist_council_runs now holds 28 real evidence rows from genuine production activity -- 12 'candidate_entry' rows from the startup catch-up paper-pick session (tickers incl. TSLA/NVDA/MU/SNDK etc, all 2/2 registered members invoked, 0 abstentions, Thompson-sampled weights differ per ticker e.g. signal_engine 0.0251-0.7695 proving real stochastic sampling not a pass-through) and 16 'mtm_exit' rows from a real force-mtm run over all 16 open positions (all 2/2 members invoked, 0 abstentions; CRTO produced a genuine non-zero weighted_vote=-0.5948 vs 0.0 for calm tickers, proving live variation). Downstream consumption confirmed by source read: candidate_entry's weighted_vote multiplies _sp['score'] (0.50-1.40x); mtm_exit's weighted_vote feeds _rules_mtm_decision()'s council<=-0.30/>=+0.30 EXIT/HOLD evidence thresholds (main.py ~L43810/43838/43860). Abstention path verified via isolated interpreter test (not persisted to prod evidence table): _build_opinion() correctly returns None+reason for each of the 3 registered names when its required input is missing, and run_council() correctly records the abstention and still returns a partial verdict from the remaining member -- proving a missing member can never silently look like a full council. Reconciled council size is 3 total registered specialists system-wide (signal_engine, technicals, fred_macro), 2 seated per context by design -- confirmed smaller than the disputed '9' claim, not chosen to satisfy the audit; GARCH/bull-bear/social-sentiment remain deliberately excluded from voting (already vote elsewhere -- market_regime_overlay.py, aiem_registry.py stage 15/19, and main.py's own StockTwits multiplier respectively -- folding them in would double-count them).
components.discrepancy_notes: RESOLVED 2026-07-10 via real code fix (not documentation correction -- prior verdict was reopened as incorrect). Root cause was a genuine Rule B violation: two call sites each independently constructed a partial council. Fix: one canonical run_council() factory in specialist_council.py, both main.py call sites refactored to use it, one new evidence table (aiem_specialist_council_runs), verbatim vote math preserved, explicit abstention records for any future missing-member case. See runtime_evidence for the live proof run (28 real rows, 2 contexts, 0 abstentions in production data, abstention path separately proven via isolated test).
